title: 第11章 至尊剑体剑意种子第12章 青莲剑诀一剑十三
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
呼呼呼……
林明义苍老的脸上浮现出笑容。
随着他的修为突破通神境七重，却没有停止。
他继续运转《星辰天罡诀》。
全身的灵力疯狂流动，继续修炼。
他卡在六重巅峰六年的沉淀，在这一刻彻底释放。
……
林毅将林山等五个林家小辈，悉数全部召集到林家祠堂。
几人都很疑惑，不知道来祠堂所为何事。
林毅见到几人到齐以后，就走上前去，将祠堂的大门关上，转身来到几人身前，对着祠堂深深鞠躬。
林山几人见状，也跟着鞠躬。
“跪下！”
林毅转过身看向林山等五个人，双眸深处弥漫着坚定的光芒，神色严肃。
玄级极品修炼功法事关重大，容不得任何闪失，稍有不慎就会给整个林家带来灭顶之灾。
噗通！
林毅平时待人宽厚沉稳，几个少年哪里见过这样的场面，当即齐刷刷就跪下去。
“你们五个当着列祖列宗的灵位发誓，接下来无论看到什么，都不得对其他人透露分毫，包括你们父母。”
“否则，五雷轰顶，不得好死！”
林毅声音低沉，蕴含气势。
林山等几个少年，也不敢有任何迟疑，就直接立誓。

“你们起来吧。”
见到几人立誓完毕，林毅对着林山等少年点点头。
几人都被林毅吓得六神无主，神情木讷。
“你们几人都是我们林家的未来，我接下来会传授你们一门玄级极品功法。”
“即日起，你们就不必再修炼《玄息诀》。”
林毅缓缓的道。
咕咚！
五人闻言，瞪大眼睛。
林山率先反应过来，道：“家主，我真的没听错，我们可以修炼玄级极品功法？”
另外的四人也回过神来，眼神之中都是期待和震惊。
他们都已经完成开脉，开始武道修炼。
就连年纪最小的林栋，也已经达到开脉境五重的境界，对修炼功法自然很了解。
玄级极品功法就连弘丰城林家都没有。
“你们凝神静气，接下来我就开始传授你们《星辰天罡诀》。”
林毅对着林山等几人说完后，就开始缓缓的将《星辰天罡诀》的修炼方法，以口授的方式传授给林山等几人。
此时此刻，他才反应过来。
林晨传授他们《星辰天罡诀》之时，使用的竟然是灵魂烙印。
按道理那可是要达到气海境，才能够使用的手段。
content_en:
Huhuhu...
A smile appeared on Lin Mingyi's old face.
As his cultivation level broke through to the seventh level of the Divine Realm, he did not stop.
He continued to operate the "Star Tiangang Jue".
The spiritual power in the whole body flows crazily and he continues to practice.
The six years of accumulation he had stuck at the sixth level peak was completely released at this moment.
…
Lin Yi summoned all the five Lin family juniors, including Lin Shan, to the Lin family ancestral hall.
Several people were very confused and didn't know why they came to the ancestral hall.
After Lin Yi saw several people arriving, he walked forward, closed the door of the ancestral hall, turned around and came to the front of the few people, and bowed deeply to the ancestral hall.
When Lin Shan and others saw this, they also bowed.
"Kneel down!"
Ji Yi turned around and looked at Lin Shan and the other five people, his eyes filled with firm light and his expression serious.
Xuan-level top-level cultivation techniques are of great importance, and there is no room for any mistakes. A slight mistake will bring disaster to the entire Lin family.
Plop!
Lin Yi usually treats others kindly and calmly, but several teenagers had never seen such a scene, and they immediately knelt down.
"The five of you swear in front of the souls of your ancestors that no matter what you see next, you will not reveal anything to anyone else, including your parents."
"Otherwise, I will be struck by five thunderbolts and I will die badly!"
Ji Yi's voice was low and full of momentum.
Lin Shan and other young men did not dare to hesitate at all and took the oath directly.
"You guys get up."
After seeing several people finish their vows, Ji Yi nodded to Lin Shan and other young men.
Several people were scared to death by Ji Yi and looked dull.
"You all are the future of our Lin family, and I will teach you a top-notch Xuan-level technique."
"From now on, you no longer need to practice the "Xuanxi Jue"."
Lin Yi said slowly.
Gudong!
When the five people heard this, their eyes widened.
Lin Shan was the first to react and said: "Master, I really heard you right. Can we practice Xuan-level top-notch skills?"
The other four people also came to their senses, their eyes filled with anticipation and shock.
They have all completed opening their meridians and started practicing martial arts.
Even the youngest Lin Dong has reached the fifth level of the Pulse Opening Realm, so he naturally understands the cultivation techniques very well.
Not even the Lin family in Hongfeng City has the ultimate Xuan-level technique.
"You guys should stay calm, and then I will start teaching you the "Star Tiangang Technique"."
After Lin Yi finished speaking to Lin Shan and others, he began to slowly teach the cultivation methods of "Star Tiangang Jue" to Lin Shan and others by dictation.
Only at this moment did he react.
When Lin Chen taught them the "Star Tiangang Jue", he actually used the soul mark.
Logically speaking, that is a method that can only be used after reaching the Qi Sea Realm.
